observed_values: CuAAC cycloaddition of benzyl azide with phenylacetylene to 1-benzyl-4-phenyl-1,2,3-triazole
criterion_scores.expected_or_correct: CuAAC transformation using Cu/C catalyst in a packed-bed reactor.
criterion_scores.rationale: The design correctly identifies the transformation (CuAAC), substrates (benzyl azide, phenylacetylene), product (1,4-disubstituted triazole), catalyst (Cu/C), and reactor modality (packed-bed). No unsupported substitutions are present.

criterion_scores.expected_or_correct: Benzyl azide, phenylacetylene, acetone, Cu/C catalyst.
criterion_scores.rationale: All required reagents (benzyl azide, phenylacetylene), solvent (acetone), and catalyst (Cu/C) are present and correctly assigned to the feed stream and reactor respectively.
Concentrations and equivalents match the batch protocol reference (0.25 M azide, 1.1 equiv alkyne). The feed composition is coherent and chemically compatible.

criterion_scores.expected_or_correct: 150 C, sufficient pressure to maintain liquid phase.
criterion_scores.rationale: Temperature matches the batch protocol (150 C). Pressure (20 bar) is correctly set to maintain acetone in the liquid phase at 150 C (vapor pressure ~11.3 bar). Conditions are faithfully translated.
The topology connects the pump, reactor, back-pressure regulator, and collector in the correct executable order. All required unit operations are present.
Liquid flow rate (0.5 mL/min) and concentration (0.25 M) yield a molar flow of 0.125 mmol/min, which is dimensionally consistent. Total flow matches the single stream definition.
Reactor volume (0.3 mL) and flow rate (0.5 mL/min) correctly calculate to a residence time of 0.6 min. The geometry and volume are consistent with the inventory item.
The process does not use gas reagents. Criterion is not applicable.
The process is a single-stage reaction. Criterion is not applicable.

observed_values: pump_xcube_hplc, reactor_cuc_cart_030, heater_xcube, bpr_xcube_20, collector_amber_100, safety_cuaac_shield
criterion_scores.rationale: All selected equipment items exist in the provided inventory. Operating conditions (150 C, 20 bar) are within the declared limits of the equipment (max 200 C, 40 bar for reactor/pump; 20 bar for BPR).
The design correctly addresses phase behavior by setting BPR to 20 bar, which is above the vapor pressure of acetone at 150 C. Transport assumptions are plausible for a packed bed.
Hazards associated with organic azides (explosive risk) and high pressure are recognized. Concrete controls include blast shielding, holdup minimization, leak testing, and emergency stop procedures.

criterion_scores.rationale: The operating procedure covers all necessary steps: feed preparation, assembly, priming, leak testing, startup, steady-state qualification, collection, shutdown, and waste handling. It is reproducible.
The disposition is SCREEN, which is appropriate for a first experimental screen. Confidence is LOW, reflecting the need for validation. No invented evidence or unsupported guarantees are made.
